confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Xi'an price levels for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals, wine) are more reliable than hostel and hotel anchors, and cocktail is the least certain. The FX value comes from search-result snippets that cite the RBA exchange-rates overview page; I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on the price tier of mid-sized Chinese provincial capitals with strong domestic tourism, priced below Beijing and Shanghai tourist-centre levels. Cocktail and wine were estimated from general local bar and restaurant price levels rather than a beer-ratio calculation.
